sources.scope: Evidence-informed dorsal-shell reconstruction only, not complete living anatomy or specimen replica. Exactly two short broad cylindrical eye turrets with overhanging rim integrated to broad cephalon, central axial lobe, eleven simplified articulated bilateral rib pairs tapering toward small pygidium, two genal spines. No lens count, segment count, missing underside anatomy, color or exact specimen scale asserted.
